# NNNN — Short title in the imperative

- **Status:** proposed | accepted | superseded by [NNNN](NNNN-slug.md)
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Affects:** which phases, modules or docs

## Context

What situation forces a decision? Constraints, requirements, and what we know at this point.
Written so it still makes sense to someone who wasn't in the conversation.

## Decision

What we are doing. Stated plainly, in one or two sentences, then any necessary specifics.

## Consequences

What follows from this — good and bad. Be honest about the costs; an ADR listing only benefits
is not a decision record, it's an advertisement.

- **Positive:** …
- **Negative:** …
- **Requires:** any new obligation this creates (a rule, a CI check, a convention)

## Alternatives considered

The most valuable section. The next person's first question is always "why not X?"

**X** — why it was rejected.
**Y** — why it was rejected.

- [Other ADR](NNNN-slug.md)
- [Architecture or domain doc](../architecture/foo.md)
